identification: John Campbell Pottery (Launceston, Tasmania) shield-shaped wall pocket / wall vase, mottled green glaze, with a relief-modelled brown koala climbing a gum branch with yellow-glazed leaves and two gumnuts at the top, H 18 cm. Back signed 'John Campbell Tasmania' with decorator initials 'K.B.L' (read as K.B.C by the cloud scan; zoom shows K.B.L or K.B.I). Small round gold/tan paper label on the front lower tip (text unreadable). Practically the identical piece sold at Shapiro (SH106, Richard Mackay collection): 'koala on a gum tree branch, mottled green glaze, back incised John Campbell Tasmania K. B. L, 18 cm'. Lot page: estimate A$350-450, current bid A$200.
